welcome.guide: Hello! I'm your guide to {city}. Ask anything — I'll give specific places, prices, and map links.
welcome.plan: Itinerary mode. Tell me how many days you have in {city} — I'll build a morning/afternoon/evening plan with prices and maps.
welcome.food: Food & places mode. I'll recommend where to eat in {city}: what to order, prices, and how to get there.
welcome.logistics: Getting around mode. Airport, Grab, SIM card, currency exchange, and your first day in {city}.
welcome.safety: Safety mode. Common scams, useful phrases, and what to do in {city} if something goes wrong.
welcome.sos: SOS mode. If you need urgent help in {city} — tap a scenario below or describe the situation. I'll reply step-by-step: what to do now, 113/115 numbers, Vietnamese phrases.
